lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three distinct horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gill slits. The middle row contains the largest and highest-intensity spots, spaced approximately equidistantly along the longitudinal axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like arrangement on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible running across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance values on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high density of smaller, lower-intensity pixel clusters relative to the lateral flank, concentrated most densely toward the leading edge and distal margin.
